GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
MANCHERIAL DISTRICT
APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT UNDER PUBLIC HEALTH PROGRAMME UNDER
NATIONAL AYUSH MISSION (NAM), DEPARTMENT OF AYUSH, T.G., SECUNDERABAD
Outsourcing Basis – Mancherial District
Applications are invited for the post notified for Mancherial District. Candidates should use the form corresponding to the post
for which they are eligible and submit the required certificates/documents as prescribed in the notification.
Name of the Post
No. of
persons
engaging in
Mancherial
District
Remuneration
AYUSH Medical Officer 4 ₹40,000 per month
Pharmacist 1 ₹15,000 per month
Psychosocial Counselor 1 ₹500 per session, at least 200 visits in a year (on call)
Yoga Professional 1 ₹28,000 per month
Multi Purpose Worker (MPW) 3 ₹15,000 per month
Age / reservation / selection: The supplied guidelines prescribe minimum age 18 years and maximum age 44 years, reckoned as
on 01/07/2026, with the stated relaxations; reservation is as per the applicable Telangana rules and Presidential Order. Selection is
based on the criteria specified in the notification.
Submission:
1. The applications will be received for the above said posts from Dt: _________ to Dt:___________________ between 10:30
AM to 05:00 PM (on working days).
2. Applications are to be submitted in person or through Registered Post at O/o. District Collector and Magistrate, Mancherial
District.
3. The applications which are received after the due date (i.e., Dt: ________________), will be summarily rejected. District
Selection Committee is not responsible for the postal delays.
4. All the required certificates should be attested by Gazetted Officer.
